
```{r settings}

library(scales)
library(DBI)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(fable)
library(tsibble)
library(gt)

theme_set(
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.margin = margin(
            t = 5.5, 
            r = 20, 
            b = 5, 
            l = 10
        ),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 10)),
        strip.clip = 'off'
        )
    )
```
